'''Kisadran''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] employed by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their [[CZ-198]] research facility, where [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Kisadran worked on the [[Vigilant]] security system&mdash;a genetically-modified [[Flesh Raider]] integrated with the electronic security of the facility. Kisadran recorded a log of the experiment's results, and after the Vigilant killed two technicians and three janitors, Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]] suggested to Kisadran that Doctor [[Teak]] be assigned to interacting with the Vigilant, as Teak was considered expendable.<ref name="Log" />
